visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short brown hair and round glasses speaks directly to the camera in a brightly lit indoor studio. She wears a beige sweater with a small red heart logo. (2) Close-up shots of a medical laser procedure on skin are shown, followed by high-resolution images of red spots and scabs on a person's cheek. (3) The woman demonstrates the use of a hydrocolloid patch, showing the product packaging. (4) A clip shows a person peeling off the patch from their face to reveal healed skin underneath. (5) A montage of skincare application and a numbered list of ingredients (Vitamin C, Arbutin, etc.) appears over various skin close-ups. (6) The video concludes with a white brand logo screen for DRX Series Skincare.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate consumers on proper post-laser skincare procedures to prevent post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation. It provides actionable advice like using hydrocolloid dressings and specific active ingredients, ultimately promoting the brand's expertise and professional care solutions.
